import json
import pathlib
import subprocess

root = pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
removed = [
    root / 'benchmarks/campaign12_profile_shapes.json',
    root / 'docs/experiments/CAMPAIGN-012.md',
    root / 'docs/experiments/CAMPAIGN-012-WORKFLOW.json',
    root / 'results/matrix-smoke.json',
    root / 'results/memory-smoke.json',
    root / 'results/profile-smoke.json',
]
caches = [
    root / '.pytest_cache',
    root / '__pycache__',
    root / 'benchmarks/__pycache__',
    root / 'tests/__pycache__',
    root / 'tools/__pycache__',
    root / 'transformer_opt/__pycache__',
    root / 'transformer_opt/kernels/__pycache__',
]
assert not any(path.exists() for path in removed)
assert not any(path.exists() for path in caches)
completed = subprocess.run(['git', 'worktree', 'list', '--porcelain'], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
worktrees = [line[9:] for line in completed.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('worktree ')]
assert len(worktrees) == 2, worktrees
retained = pathlib.Path('C:/Users/jared/AppData/Local/Codex/worktrees/tiktok-techjam-2026-c7-exp018').resolve()
assert retained.exists()
for relative in ['torch_transformer_benchmark.py', 'tests/test_gpu_transformer.py', 'transformer_opt/kernels/__init__.py']:
    active_text = (root / relative).read_text(encoding='utf-8').replace('\r\n', '\n')
    retained_text = (retained / relative).read_text(encoding='utf-8').replace('\r\n', '\n')
    assert active_text == retained_text, relative
output = {
    'removed_scaffold_and_smoke_files': len(removed),
    'cache_directories_absent': len(caches),
    'remaining_worktrees': worktrees,
    'retained_candidate_source_normalized_equal': True,
    'curated_result_json_count': len(list((root / 'docs/results').glob('*.json'))),
    'campaign12_attempt_count': len(list((root / 'docs/experiments/attempts').glob('C12-*.json'))),
}
assert output['curated_result_json_count'] == 361
assert output['campaign12_attempt_count'] == 0
print(json.dumps(output, indent=2))
